title: Rectangular base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a closed loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and extends horizontally to (0.75, 0.0). The second line then moves vertically from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0234). The third line travels horizontally back to (0.0, 0.0234), and the fourth line completes the loop by returning to the origin. Apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector of zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0547 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional solid body. Ensure that this extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction of the normal. The resulting rectangular base has a length of 0.7500000000000001 units, a width of 0.023437500000000003 units, and a height of 0.05468750000000001 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0234) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0234) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.0547)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(length_x, width_y, height_z, centered=(True, True, True))
